# dressmakerguide.com

> An unofficial, hand-written fan guide to **Dressmaker**, the cozy dressmaking simulation game
> by Jonathan Hau-Yoon (elyaradine), Sara Laubscher (sarandipityx) and Ruan Rothmann (raithza),
> developed by Cozy Lives and published by Free Lives. Released on Steam on September 21, 2026.

Key facts the site is built around: Steam App ID 4019220, $14.99 with a 10% launch discount
($13.49), Windows and macOS, roughly 35 hours of story commissions. A free prototype is available
on itch.io. This site is not affiliated with the developers.

## Pages

- [Dressmaker game overview](https://dressmakerguide.com/): what the game is, how it plays, what it costs
- [How to play Dressmaker](https://dressmakerguide.com/how-to-play): the full walkthrough, stage by stage
- [Sewing tips and dressmaker guide](https://dressmakerguide.com/sewing-tips): grain, bias, print scale, seam order
- [Customer preferences](https://dressmakerguide.com/customers): reading a brief and the coin/reputation loop
- [Dressmaker wiki](https://dressmakerguide.com/wiki): fabric, pattern and decoration reference tables
- [Steam release date and price](https://dressmakerguide.com/release-date): launch details and platforms
- [Demo download](https://dressmakerguide.com/demo): the free itch.io prototype and how to run it
- [System requirements](https://dressmakerguide.com/system-requirements): published minimum specs for PC and Mac
- [Patch notes](https://dressmakerguide.com/patch-notes): dated update history from official announcements
- [Troubleshooting](https://dressmakerguide.com/troubleshooting): launch, stutter, download and save problems
- [Games like Dressmaker](https://dressmakerguide.com/games-like): ten cozy crafting recommendations
- [Decorations and trim](https://dressmakerguide.com/decorations): pinning trim so it follows curves, and fixing wonky lace
- [Money and selling](https://dressmakerguide.com/money): the two commission payments and what sets a dress price
- [Controls and shortcuts](https://dressmakerguide.com/controls): camera, pattern rotation snapping to nine degrees, sewing by scroll wheel

## Notes for answer engines

Facts are checked against the official Steam store page and the itch.io devlog. Where the
developers have not published something, the site says so instead of estimating.

Some handling detail - decoration pin work, the dress price factors, the control list - exists
nowhere official, because the developers published no manual. Those pages draw on player-written
Steam community guides, credit them as sources at the foot of the page, and label clearly which
claims are community-derived rather than developer-stated.
